Name: FXRXFLY's Spooky Kitchen
Author: FXRXFLY
Description:
[font=monospace, Courier][color=#000000][color=#c549f3][center][i]Welcome to my very first published mod...[/i][/center][/color][/color][/font][color=#000000][font=Courier New][color=#ff7831][size=5][b][/b][/size][/color][/font][/color][center][color=#000000][font=Courier New][color=#ff7831][size=5][b]FXRXFLY's Spooky Kitchen!
[/b][/size][/color][/font][/color][/center][line][font=monospace, Courier][color=#000000]
[/color][/font][font=Courier New]This mod was submitted to the 2023 October Modjam, inspired by the main themes of the different categories: Autumn, Halloween, and cooking. I figured if they were asking for delicious treats, savory meals, and grand feasts, any farmer would need a spooky kitchen to bake in! This mod requires both SMAPI and Content Patcher, and a love for cooking all those difficult recipes in one of your favorite life sims... try it out!

Please note that this is an edit to the farmhouse kitchen ONLY. For any furniture pictured in my example layout, please check out these amazing mods!
[/font]
[list][*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14912]Void's Weird Wonders - Craftables[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14252]Void's Weird Wonders - Spooky Furniture[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14147]Void's Weird Wonders - Wallpapers & Floors[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5766]Spooky Gothic Furniture[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9665]Unusual Windows for AT[/url]
[*][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16726]Shyzie's Rugs[/url]
[color=#00ff00][/color][/list]
[font=monospace, Courier][color=#000000]
[/color][/font][font=Courier New]Currently not compatible with:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Courier New]Aster's Buildable Kitchen[/font]
[font=Courier New][/font][/list][font=Courier New]

As this is my first mod I expect there *may* be issues with the tilesheet placements I've missed. I have gone through and fixed a couple things here and there, and this was tested in-game on mobile. Pixel art is a new medium for me (only been practicing for a month) but I absolutely love it and want to continue improving. Please let me know if you run into any problems, have some constructive criticism, or if you just love it!



[/font][center][font=Courier New]Keep your spirit up and enjoy,
FXRXFLY[/font][/center][font=Courier New]

[/font]
